_about: H6 Too hot, just right (docs/modes/clinic-design.md Q4 H6; contract docs/clinic-heal-api.md; js/clinic/heal/games/fever.js). The conversation game: the thermometer's reading, then the patient's answers, decide each step and when to stop. The patient's face never shows hot or cold (it would give the answer away); only the words do. A wrong step changes nothing (he says it again); a step after 'just right' tips him over the other way. Level 1 is three or four exchanges (not the design's one: one binary exchange is 50% blind); blind odds about 1/2 per exchange x 1/2 for when to stop. There is no Kutchi yet for hot, cold, still cold, too hot or just right: those rows are English placeholders (grey italic) until the family gives the words; the counts (Cook's numbers) and jaldi/aastethi (Cook's drafts) are real.

1.note: The reading, then two or three answers in either direction, then Done on just right. Every step is one tap-tap (the fan: a few wafts, then it's put down or rests).

2.note: The reading comes with a count (Cold! trae [blankets] / Hot! [fan], ba [times]); the count closes when the item is put down or Done is pressed.

3.note: Plus the fan's speed on every later too-hot step ([fan], jaldi! / aastethi), judged by the rhythm of the taps (at least three wafts).
